name: safeFront
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent world object for an ink-painted first-person dungeon game, viewed midground at about 200 px tall. Input 1 is the installed room: match its perspective, broad quiet planes, restrained diffuse values and substantial large black shadow masses. Input 2 is the primary original drawing-language reference: selective drawn contours, very few interior marks and simple forms; not a glossy game icon. Input 3 is supplied Darkest Dungeon atmosphere reference: weight, pooled black, no cute proportions. Must blend into the room as a physical thing, not a collectible button. No bright rim, uniform black sticker outline, glossy bevels, tiny scratches, repeated facets, dense texture, gradients in background or drop-shadow vignette. Pure transparent background. One object only; no sheet, no labels, no border. Camera at standing human eye, modest downward view: see only a little of horizontal top planes, no overhead isometric view. Visible whole object with quiet 10% transparent padding. Diffuse upper-left room light; undersides and recesses merge into large near-black shapes. Front means frontal main face with a small amount of right depth, vanishing lines converging gently at eye level above object.
SUBJECT: low rectangular medieval treasury strongbox made of dull blackened iron, very heavy; one simple broad iron strap and plain latch, lid cracked only a finger-width with barely a few muted brass coins inside, NO glitter. The entire safe leans precariously about 15 degrees to its right onto ONE worn stone slab wedge underneath; slab narrow and unstable, chipped at one load-bearing contact. A grounded physical contour with heavy dark underside and cast-contact shape incorporated tightly at slab bottom. No hanging bag, handle loops, decorative gold badge, magic, chains, extra cargo, characters, puddles or scenery. New rugged design, NOT barrel-shaped wooden fantasy chest. Front view.
